## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `LifecycleManagement`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `lifecycle-management`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **LifecycleManagement**.

## Step 2: Manage the lifecycle of an API

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select the project. -->
3. <!-- manual: In the Integrations pane, click on the integration for which you want to manage the lifecycle. -->
4. <!-- manual: Navigate to the lifecycle management page using one of the following options: -->
5. <!-- manual: In the integration overview page, click Lifecycle Status. -->
6. <!-- manual: In the left navigation menu, under Develop, click Lifecycle. -->
7. You will see a lifecycle state transition diagram showing the integration's current state. The possible next states you can apply are displayed above the diagram. If the integration has multiple endpoints, use the endpoint selector on the page to switch between them. The lifecycle state change applies only to the currently selected endpoint. Click on a required lifecycle state to apply it to the integration. For example, if an integration is in the `CREATED` state, you can click either `PRE-RELEASED` or `PUBLISHED`.
